title: Correlation and cross-section
status: gate met - three-well correlation, datum flattening, missing-datum and pinch-out checks, a cross-section from real coordinates, paginated PDF export, and a render that is cancelled between wells when the well set changes

implementation.tools: TheTechIdea.OilGas.Wellbore — CorrelationPanel, CorrelationLayout.Build, CorrelationRenderer.Draw, MarkerMatching, PanelExport.CorrelationPages / ToPdf

gates.AC-1 three wells align on a chosen marke: pass — three deterministic demo wells; two carry 'Top B' at different depths and, after the tools' flattening, each lands at the same axis position (asserted to 1 decimal). Their offsets differ because the marker is at a different depth in each well, which is exactly the shift flattening applies.
gates.AC-2 a well missing the datum is marked: pass — DEMO-3 carries tops but not the datum: the checks list 'correlation-datum-missing' naming it, its column reports HasDatum=false with an offset of exactly 0, and its datum position is not computable (NaN) rather than invented
gates.AC-3 pinch-outs and missing tops appear: pass - a well with no tops is reported as correlation-no-tops, and pinch-outs are read from the tools' CrossSectionLayout.Horizons terminations: 3 pinch-outs on the demo set, each message naming the horizon and both wells (e.g. Top B between DEMO-2 and DEMO-3). A negative control (every well carries every top) produces none, so the check is not always-true. The section checks are merged into the page's checks grid.
gates.AC-4 a cross-section uses the real well: pass - OgCorrelation.BuildSection places each well at its X/Y, draws the line through the outermost two, and CrossSectionLayout.Paths projects the wells onto it at true distance (0 / ~1516 / ~3245 ft for the demo positions). A well without a position is refused with correlation-no-coordinates instead of being drawn at zero. The page shows the section in its own tab, rendered from the same CrossSectionRenderer the tools use.
gates.AC-5 PDF export paginates correctly for: pass — PanelExport.CorrelationPages gives the page count and ToPdf writes exactly that many pages; the file starts with %PDF-
gates.AC-6 changing the well set cancels any p: pass - OgCorrelation.RenderChunked checks the token between wells, before the frame and after it, so a cancel is observed at the next well boundary and a cancel during the draw discards the frame. The page holds a CTS, cancels it when a new render starts, and returns nothing for a superseded render, so no stale frame can be applied. Tests: a cancel after the first well is observed (progress stops at 1); a pre-cancelled token does no work and produces no frame; and a page render of 120 wells superseded by a 3-well render returns null for the first and the 3-well panel for the second.

limits: Wells are the deterministic demo set (three documents built from the triple-combo template with markers); no PPDM tops were read (DAT-02, G-08).
The datum choice is a combo box of the shared tops plus '(none)'; there is no well picker for 2-20 wells and no map inset.
The cross-section view, real coordinates, pinch-out detection and the per-well shift editor are not built.
The correlation PDF is written by the smoke run and by tests under the data root; the header/legend text is not read back.
